Flow.description: Tweaks to how FICO is handled--replace 0 (missing) FICOs with 500, at least in terms of what the flow sees and uses.

formulas.name: formCreditReviewCommercialQualified
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!varCommericalPrequalified})), {!varCommericalPrequalified}, IF( ({!varDealOrigination} = 'MCA_Oppty' || {!varDealOrigination} = 'Broker_WC_Oppty') && ({!varAnnualRevenue} >= 3000000 && NOT(ISBLANK({!varAnnualRevenue}))) && ({!varMinFicoScore} >= 575 && NOT(ISBLANK({!varMaxFicoScore}))) && ({!varAvgNumberOfNegativeDays} <= 5 || ISBLANK({!varAvgNumberOfNegativeDays})) && ({!varBkDischargeDate} < {!$Flow.CurrentDate} - 730 || ISBLANK({!varBkDischargeDate})) && ({!varPg1BkDischargeDate} < {!$Flow.CurrentDate} - 730 || ISBLANK({!varPg1BkDischargeDate})) && ({!varPg2BkDischargeDate} < {!$Flow.CurrentDate} - 730 || ISBLANK({!varPg2BkDischargeDate})), 'Commercial Approvable', 'Commercial Decline'))

formulas.description: If varMaxFicoScore is 0 then we set FICO used by the flow to 500. If varMaxFicoScore is greater than 0 then we use the actual FICO. This is intended to ensure that missing or zero FICOs are still seen by the analysts.
formulas.name: formMaxFicoScore500
formMaxTier
formulas.expression: IF({!varDealOrigination} = 'Broker_WC_Oppty' && ISBLANK({!varSicBrokerMaxTier}), 'Invalid SIC Code', IF({!varDealOrigination} = 'MCA_Oppty' && ISBLANK({!varSicNfMaxTier}), 'Invalid SIC Code', IF({!varDealOrigination} = 'Broker_WC_Oppty' && NOT(ISBLANK({!varSicBrokerMaxTier})), {!varSicBrokerMaxTier}, IF({!varDealOrigination} = 'MCA_Oppty' && NOT(ISBLANK({!varSicNfMaxTier})),{!varSicNfMaxTier}, 'Error'))))

formulas.description: Finds the maximum of Years in Business (from Opportunity) and Time in Business (from Credit Review)
formulas.name: formMaxTimeInBusiness
formQueueDecision
formulas.expression: IF({!assignWcCreditDecisionRecomendation} = 'Auto Decline' || {!assignWcCreditDecisionRecomendation} = 'NF Auto Decline' || {!assignWcCreditDecisionRecomendation} = 'Decline', True, False)

formulas.description: In the past we used to use the actual Time In Business in calculating the ten point score and recommendations for a submission, but now we're essentially giving everyone a "pass" and 1 point toward the score.
formulas.name: formTimeInBusinessScore
formWcDecisionCommercialQualified
formulas.expression: IF( ({!varDealOrigination} = 'MCA_Oppty' || {!varDealOrigination} = 'Broker_WC_Oppty') && ({!varAnnualRevenue} >= 3000000 && NOT(ISBLANK({!varAnnualRevenue}))) && ({!varMinFicoScore} >= 575 && NOT(ISBLANK({!varMaxFicoScore}))) && ({!varAvgNumberOfNegativeDays} <= 5 || ISBLANK({!varAvgNumberOfNegativeDays})) && ({!varBkDischargeDate} < {!$Flow.CurrentDate} - 730 || ISBLANK({!varBkDischargeDate})) && ({!varPg1BkDischargeDate} < {!$Flow.CurrentDate} - 730 || ISBLANK({!varPg1BkDischargeDate})) && ({!varPg2BkDischargeDate} < {!$Flow.CurrentDate} - 730 || ISBLANK({!varPg2BkDischargeDate})), 'Commercial Approvable', 'Commercial Decline')
